run.description: Position-memory extraction (live_extract.py, chunked structured extraction), full-archive pass. Cost basis: the 2026-10-05 OpenRouter run of 1,442 chats cost $7.69.

moves.reason: Measured 2026-10-06 (lane A, 34-chat pilot, PR #175): capturing moves in the same pass costs f = 0.11 of the pass (bootstrap 95% interval 0.06 to 0.18 against a same-day rerun; widest defensible 0.03 to 0.18). Rule f*C < p*R: 0.18*7.69 = $1.38 < 0.5*7.69 = $3.85, so capture. p in [0.5, 0.9] is the coordinating agent's estimate: the need has already occurred once (the how-Brian-reasons goal) and reasoning methods are a standing aim.
moves.note: From now on extraction runs capture moves (finish_pipeline.sh sets INQUIRY_EXTRACT_MOVES=1; the check refuses a run that lacks it). The 2,176 existing graphs still have 0 moves: a backfill re-runs every chat (about C*(1+f) = $8.5 at today's cost) and needs Brian's decision. Prompt quality is uneven (test, deduce, generalize, retract nearly absent; ask is over a third of all moves).
